description: This file contains unit tests for the 'failover-policy' module, testing decision logic functions 'resolveRunFailoverDecision' and 'mergeRetryFailoverReason'. It uses 'vitest' testing framework and imports specific functions from the './failover-policy.js' file.

methods.name: resolveRunFailoverDecision
methods.description: Determines the failover action based on current stage and conditions during a run, such as retry limit, prompt, or assistant stage.

methods.name: mergeRetryFailoverReason
methods.description: Merges previous and current failover reasons, prioritizing timeout or preserving the previous reason if current is null.
